enrichment.headline: Pays Soccer Without Borders up to $124,440 for after-school soccer, tutoring and mentoring for teen boys
enrichment.summary: Soccer Without Borders will run year-round after-school and weekend soccer training and games for middle and high school aged boys. It will also provide school-day academic tracking, tutoring, mentoring, social-emotional learning groups and help returning to school, plus team trips such as hikes, camping, college visits and soccer games. The work runs through the English Language Learner and Multilingual Achievement Department from October 1, 2026 to June 30, 2027.
